errors.text_span: Най-голям дял, 61%, е представен от автомагистралите
errors.evidence: The 61% share corresponds to 'Третокласни' (Third-class) roads, not 'автомагистрали' (Motorways).
The color of the largest slice (61%) is brown, not red.
First-class roads ('Първокласни') have a 15% share, not 20%. The 20% share belongs to second-class roads.
Second-class roads ('Второкласни') have a 20% share, not 15%. The 15% share belongs to first-class roads.
Third-class roads ('Третокласни') have a 61% share, not 4%. The 4% share belongs to motorways ('Автомагистрали').
The description introduces a non-existent fifth segment, which is confusing and incorrect as the chart only has four.
The segment for motorways ('автомагистралите'), which is 4%, is orange, not dark brown. The dark brown color corresponds to the 61% segment (third-class roads).

errors.evidence: The description states that information will be added to the chart, which is a hallucination of a future action not depicted in the figure.
